name: The Naming Tithe
description: A long, arduous Forum ritual, unused for half a century, in which delegates name themselves and each other.

timeline.summary: At the Naming Tithe, Crown and Verdis name themselves and each other, but the conciliators' words turn jagged and Embrose plunges the hall into darkness.
timeline.quote: Their words never met the water.
